calls.head: Daccord’s hold on the Golden Knights won’t last
calls.body: Since 2023-24, Daccord has been a wall against the Golden Knights, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Golden Knights finally get to him.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Four points for Hertl as The Golden Knights beat the Kraken
paras: Mark Stone had a Gordie Howe hat trick: a goal, an assist and a fight. Victor Olofsson struck first for the Golden Knights midway through the first, and the goal stood after the Kraken challenged for goalie interference. Tomáš Hertl stretched the lead to 2-0 on the power play 2:56 later. Stone made it 3-0 shorthanded early in the second. Olofsson scored his second of the night midway through the second to make it 4-0. Jack Eichel stretched the lead to 5-0 late in the second. Seattle pulled Joey Daccord after five goals and turned to Philipp Grubauer to start the third. Shane Wright got the Kraken on the board early in the third. Hertl scored his second of the night on the power play 4:51 later to make it 6-1 for the Knights. Jared McCann cut it to 6-2 on the power play with 5:00 left. Hertl also had two assists. Eichel finished with four points: a goal and three assists.
The Golden Knights carried the play, and got the result to match. Carter Hart made 25 saves for the Golden Knights.

There were two fights: Brandon Montour with Stone and Marc Gatcomb with Ryan Winterton. Ben Meyers was thrown out with a game misconduct midway through the third. For Stone, it was his first fight since January 2026. The Golden Knights moved to 3-1-0, and the Kraken fell to 2-2-0.

items.text: Jack Eichel extended his point streak against Seattle to nine games.
All four of the preview’s calls held.
